findings.title: Forgotten contingency has a repair loop
findings.claim: The rule anticipates fallible memory and prescribes recovery: remember, speak again without self-certainty, and redirect the plan toward nearer right guidance.
findings.mechanism: The focus utterance is followed in 18:24 by remembering after forgetting, renewed saying, guidance, nearness, and right direction. These independent acts turn the prohibition into a recoverable speech-and-guidance loop rather than a terminal failure after omission.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see a practical continuation after forgetting: the speech act is repaired through remembrance, renewed wording, and a request for guidance.
findings.containment: The exact trace is legacy_unbound and the unresolved context branches remain attributed. The next ayah may also speak broadly about remembrance and guidance; this finding does not reduce it to one repair function.

epistemic.reason: The sequence and coordinates are fully supplied, but the HFT source is legacy_unbound and most contextual branch identities are unresolved.

findings.title: Future certainty as micro-jurisdiction
findings.claim: Exploratorily, categorical future agency can sound like a miniature claim to govern the speaker's future causal field.
findings.mechanism: The focus active producer supplies the self-named causal agent, while 18:26 supplies the contact of shared authority and delegated judgment. Their meeting shifts the pressure from prediction alone toward who may guarantee an outcome, while remaining a rhetorical reading of the speech act.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the force of the first-person producer claim as a pressure on jurisdiction, not only as a confident calendar statement.
findings.containment: This is exploratory and explicitly does not accuse ordinary planning of theological association. The unresolved branches have no invented gloss or facet, and the focus's ordinary planning context remains recoverable.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record is exact and its anchors agree, but its own containment marks the jurisdictional movement as exploratory and the two context branches are unresolved.
